title: Formulas & Functions
source: ICT Grade 3 (Nile International) Block 2 Week 4 Study sheet pp.34-39

scenes.t: A formula is an expression that calculates a value in Excel. Every formula starts with an equal sign.
For example, select cell A3 and write equal, A1 plus A2, then press Enter. Excel adds the two cells for you.
If you change the number in A1 or A2, Excel automatically calculates the answer again.
You can use the fill handle to copy a formula to the other cells.
Functions are made to make your work simpler and faster. A function can do simple or complex calculations.
SUM adds numbers together, like equal SUM, A1 to A4.
MAX finds the biggest value. MIN finds the smallest value.
COUNT counts how many cells contain numbers. AVERAGE finds the average of the values.
For example, to add the numbers 4 and 5, write equal SUM, A2 to B2, in cell C2. The answer is 9.
